verdict.rationale: Anomaly and duplicate monitoring is a fair question for accounting software like sevDesk, but the pack contains no documented agent or feature that watches the ledger and flags unusual spend or duplicate transactions before the close. What it does show falls short. The dashboard only displays income and expenses, the missing-receipt hints are a different feature, and the REST API is just a building block a developer would have to turn into such a monitor.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent monitor the ledger and flag anomalies in spend or duplicate transactions before the close
